process visit.reminder v1
Subject: case
Stages: [reminder]
Start: remind
Accepts: [case.reply_received, visit.confirmed]
Requires: [reminder@1]
Variables: [{Name=case_ref, Type=Code, IsInput=true}, {Name=visit_at, Type=Instant, IsInput=true}, {Name=reply_kind, Type=Code, IsInput=false}]
Windows: [{Name=contact_hours, Zone=America/New_York, Days=[Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday], From=09:00, To=18:00}]
Scenarios: [a reply interrupts the wait for the contact hours, the window opens first and the reminder goes out, a reply while the reminder is being sent is kept and does not interrupt, no confirmation two hours before the visit goes to a person, a visit that is too close for the wait goes to a person at once, a call still open when the visit starts lapses]
step remind
  Kind: Action
  Stage: reminder
  Routes: [{Label=next, Target=await_confirmation}, {Label=onError, Target=call_patient}, {Label=onUnknown, Target=call_patient}, {Label=interrupt, Target=handle_reply}]
  Port: messaging.reminder
  Delivery: AtMostOnce
  IsContact: true
  Window: contact_hours
  Retry: {MaxAttempts=1, Backoff=none, Initial=00:00:00}
  Interrupt: {Event=case.reply_received, Correlation=case_ref, Target=handle_reply, Output=[{Name=reply_kind, Variable=reply_kind}]}
  Inputs: [{Name=case, Variable=case_ref}]
  InputNames: [case_ref]
  OutputNames: [reply_kind]
step await_confirmation
  Kind: Wait
  Stage: reminder
  Routes: [{Label=next, Target=confirmed}, {Label=onTimeout, Target=call_patient}]
  Event: visit.confirmed
  Correlation: case_ref
  Timeout: {Variable=visit_at, Offset=-02:00:00}
  InputNames: [case_ref, visit_at]
step handle_reply
  Kind: HumanTask
  Stage: reminder
  Routes: [{Label=on:handled, Target=confirmed}, {Label=onTimeout, Target=lapsed}]
  Queue: front_desk
  Outcomes: [handled]
  Show: [case_ref, reply_kind]
  Timeout: {Variable=visit_at, Offset=-01:00:00}
  InputNames: [case_ref, reply_kind, visit_at]
step call_patient
  Kind: HumanTask
  Stage: reminder
  Routes: [{Label=on:reached, Target=confirmed}, {Label=on:unreachable, Target=unreachable}, {Label=onTimeout, Target=lapsed}]
  Queue: front_desk
  Outcomes: [reached, unreachable]
  Show: [case_ref]
  Timeout: {Variable=visit_at, Offset=00:00:00}
  InputNames: [case_ref, visit_at]
step confirmed
  Kind: End
  Stage: reminder
  Result: confirmed
step unreachable
  Kind: End
  Stage: reminder
  Result: unreachable
step lapsed
  Kind: End
  Stage: reminder
  Result: lapsed
